hooks.command:
input="$(cat)"
if printf '%s' "$input" | jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi
cwd="$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
[ -n "$cwd" ] && cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
transcript="$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)"
[ -f "$transcript" ] || exit 0
git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0
last=$(jq -r 'select(.type=="assistant") | .message.content[]? | select(.type=="tool_use") | if (.name=="Write" or .name=="Edit") and ((.input.file_path // "") | endswith("docs/commands.md")) then "DOCS" elif .name=="Bash" and ((.input.command // "") | test("curl|tsx")) then "TRIGGER" else empty end' "$transcript" 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
[ "$last" = "TRIGGER" ] || exit 0
reason="You ran curl and/or tsx commands to validate behavior, but docs/commands.md has not been updated since. Log the key curl/tsx commands used for validation into docs/commands.md before finishing (commands only, not raw response output such as curl -i headers)."
jq -cn --arg r "$reason" '{decision:"block", reason:$r}'
